question: Prop 22 pays California drivers 120% of the $16.50 minimum for engaged time only. Excluding mileage, what is that per logged-in hour at 60% engagement?
move: Before comparing a pay floor, ask which hours it counts.
ask: Which hours does my pay actually count and which does it quietly leave out?
trap: Reading 120% of the minimum wage as pay for every hour online.
hint: Waiting for a request counts as logged in but not as engaged.
steps: Only 60% of logged-in time is engaged.
reference: California Proposition 22, Protect App-Based Drivers and Services Act, Business and Professions Code sections 7448-7467, 2020
